# SG Caribbean Transfers & Tours

> Private airport transfers, cruise-port pickups and private day tours on the
> north coast of the Dominican Republic — Sosúa, Cabarete, Puerto Plata,
> Playa Dorada and the wider country. Family-run, licensed and insured.
> Fixed prices per vehicle (not per person), no prepayment, pay the driver
> on arrival in cash (USD or DOP) or by PayPal, Cash App or Zelle.

Website: https://caribbeansgtransferstours.com/
WhatsApp / phone: +1 829-627-7733
Email: sg.caribbeantransferstours@gmail.com
Based in: Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic
Languages spoken by drivers: English, Spanish
Site languages: English at the root, Spanish under /es/, French under /fr/ —
  every page exists in all three, at its own URL, linked by hreflang
Booking channel: WhatsApp message or the on-site request form — no online prepayment

## What the company does

- **Airport transfers** — private door-to-door from POP (Puerto Plata /
  Gregorio Luperón), STI (Santiago / Cibao), SDQ (Santo Domingo / Las
  Américas), AZS (Samaná / El Catey) and PUJ (Punta Cana) to any destination
  in the country. Flights are tracked in real time; the driver waits at no
  extra cost if the flight is delayed. Meet & greet with a name sign.
- **Full-day private driver** — a private driver and van for up to 15 guests,
  quoted on request. Fuel, all trips within Sosúa and Cabarete and one
  round trip to Puerto Plata are included; other destinations are
  quoted separately. The driver works day or night, up to 14 hours within the
  same 24-hour period, with at least 8 consecutive hours of rest between
  shifts. Tips are not included and not required.
- **Cruise shore excursions** — pickup at Amber Cove and Taino Bay in Puerto
  Plata, with a guaranteed return to the pier before all-aboard time.
- **Private day tours** — the whole vehicle is yours; no shared buses, no
  strangers, no fixed group schedule.

Vehicles: private car (up to 3 guests), minivan (up to 6), van (up to 10),
minibus (up to 15). Child and booster seats are free on request.

included. Pickup from Sosúa, Cabarete, Puerto Plata, Playa Dorada or the
cruise piers.

Groups larger than 6 are quoted on request.

## Destinations covered in detail

Each of these has its own page with the confirmed fare, how to arrive by air and
by cruise, what is in the town, and a FAQ.

**Sosua** — reef-sheltered horseshoe bay on the north coast, calm water,
snorkelling from the sand, and the small museum of the 1940 Jewish settlement.
Fixed fare from POP: **US$23.95**.

**Cabarete** — the kitesurfing, windsurfing and surfing town, just east of
Sosua. Kite Beach, Playa Encuentro and El Choco National Park.
Fixed fare from POP: **US$33.95**.

**Puerto Plata and Playa Dorada** — the main city of the north coast and the
location of both the airport (POP) and both cruise terminals. Fortaleza San
Felipe, the Pico Isabel de Torres cable car, the Victorian centre and the
Malecon; Playa Dorada is the gated resort strip just east.
Fixed fare from POP: **US$38.95**, covering the city and Playa Dorada alike.

**Cofresi and Costambar** — the resort and villa strip immediately west of
Puerto Plata city, home of the Ocean World Adventure Park. Costambar next door
is residential, with a long calm beach. The Amber Cove cruise pier is in the
neighbouring bay at Maimon, making this the closest beach to any pier on the
coast. Fixed fare from POP: **US$48.50**, covering both.

**Rio San Juan and Playa Grande** — the quiet eastern end of the north coast, in
Maria Trinidad Sanchez province. The Gri-Gri mangrove lagoon, and the
cliff-backed Atlantic beaches of Playa Caleton, Playa Grande and Playa Preciosa.
Fixed fare from POP: **US$98.50**, covering both.

**Las Terrenas and the Samana peninsula** — a beach town on the north side of
the Samana peninsula: Playa Bonita, Playa Coson, Playa Las Ballenas, the El
Limon waterfall inland, and Samana Bay with Cayo Levantado on the southern side.
Most visitors arrive through Puerto Plata (POP) or Santo Domingo (SDQ) and cross
by road. Fixed fares: **US$178.50 from POP**, **US$219 from Santo Domingo (SDQ)** and
**US$425 from Punta Cana (PUJ)**. The Santiago fare is quoted on request.
Las Terrenas does **not** fit inside a Puerto Plata cruise port call; it is only
a short trip if a ship is calling at Samana Bay itself, which is a different port.

## Cabarete

Cabarete is a beach town on the north coast of the Dominican Republic, in the
province of Puerto Plata, on the coastal highway just east of Sosua. It is
built along a single street between the beach and the hills and is known
worldwide for kitesurfing, windsurfing and surfing. Kite Beach lies just west
of town; Playa Encuentro, the north coast's surf break, sits on the road
towards Sosua; El Choco National Park, with its lagoon and swimmable limestone
caves, is directly behind the town.

Fixed one-way fares to Cabarete, per vehicle, 1 to 6 guests:
**US$33.95 from Puerto Plata (POP)**, **US$98.95 from Santiago (STI)**,
**US$219 from Santo Domingo (SDQ)** and **US$425 from Punta Cana (PUJ)**. The
fare from Samana (AZS) is quoted on request and deliberately not published,
because it is not yet confirmed.
Cruise passengers are collected at both Puerto Plata piers, Taino Bay and
Amber Cove.

Boards and board bags are carried at no surcharge, but the count must be given
when booking so the right vehicle is sent. There is **no Uber or Lyft** in
Cabarete.

## Key distances and drive times to Sosúa

- Puerto Plata Airport (POP) → Sosúa: ~9 km, about 10–15 minutes
- Santiago Airport (STI) → Sosúa: ~85 km, about 1 h 30
- Samaná Airport (AZS) → Sosúa: ~155 km, about 2 h 30
- Santo Domingo Airport (SDQ) → Sosúa: ~245 km, about 4 h
- Cabarete → Sosúa: ~8 km, about 10 minutes
- Amber Cove and Taino Bay cruise piers → Sosúa: about 30–40 minutes

There is **no Uber or Lyft** service in Sosúa; a pre-booked private transfer
or a local taxi are the practical options.
